scripts.build: bun run check && bun --bun node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build
scripts.smoke: bun scripts/database-smoke.ts && bun scripts/smoke.ts && bun scripts/worker-smoke.ts && bun scripts/ui-smoke.ts && bun scripts/verify-bundle.ts && bun scripts/finish-smoke.ts
scripts.lint: bun lint --no-script --type-aware --max-warnings=0 app src scripts spacetimedb/src next.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: bun lint --no-script --type-aware --max-warnings=0 --fix app src scripts spacetimedb/src next.config.ts
scripts.format: bun fmt --no-script app src scripts next.config.ts spacetimedb/src spacetimedb/bindings spacetimedb/package.json spacetimedb/tsconfig.json spacetimedb/README.md package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md
scripts.format:check: bun fmt --no-script --check app src scripts next.config.ts spacetimedb/src spacetimedb/bindings spacetimedb/package.json spacetimedb/tsconfig.json spacetimedb/README.md package.json tsconfig.json bunfig.toml README.md
scripts.quality: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test
